comments.body: Legal asked for a watermark option—adding a non-default “Shared from Nimbus” footer before we call this review-ready.

content.text: Legal asked for a watermark option—adding a non-default “Shared from Nimbus” footer before we call this review-ready.
Stakeholders often need to see a dashboard without burning a paid seat. Today the only options are full invites or static screenshots that rot immediately.

Introduce a read-only share link: workspace admins generate a link token with optional expiry (7 / 30 / never) and optional password. GET /public/dashboards/{token} renders widgets without edit chrome, live data refresh every 60s, and no sidebar navigation into the rest of the app.
Acceptance includes revoke, rotate, audit log entry on create/revoke, rate limit of 120 req/min per token, and blocked access when the parent dashboard is deleted.
